title: Pokemon Surging Sparks Night Stretcher 251/191 In Hand! Gold Secret Rare
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Pokémon card is a must-have for any serious collector. With its stunning gold detail and full art design, the Surging Sparks Night Stretcher 251/191 card is sure to be the centerpiece of your collection. This card is a Trainer-Item type and features Pikachu as the character/monster type. 

The card is made of high-quality card stock and has a foil finish, making it a durable and valuable addition to your collection. Manufactured by The Pokémon Company and illustrated by 5ban Graphics, this card is a Secret Rare with an EX speciality. It is standard size and suitable for ages 6+. Don't miss out on this amazing opportunity to add this card to your collection!
